race.comment: KEEP IT REAL (1) was held up on the turn and beaten a nose at the Sunshine Coast in a CG CL1. With the apprentice claim helping offset the top weight he can go one better here. WAVERLEY (7) is back from a spell with a recent Gold Coast trial. Returns shy of a preferred trip but this is a starting point and if they overdo it in front he can play a role late. OUTTA REEF (9) resumes after six months and has had two trials. Worth consideration. LADY WINDERMERE (13) was wide throughout at Eagle Farm when seventh over 1400m and better judged on her second at this track two back. Include. INQUICKTIME (2) can improve second-up.
